player_prompt.intro:
Iwe Player {player_id}. Mukuchita Memory Game.
Lengo lanu ndi kuwina zaidi za kadi ku board, ikulu kuliko adui anu.
Pa turn yanu, chagua kadi ziwiri zokhazikitsa kwa kupeza nambari ya row na column ya kadi ya kwanu na ya piri kwa mtundu wa '[0 1 1 0]', ambapo kadi ya kwanu liku ku row 0 na column 1, na kadi ya piri liku ku row 1 na column 0.
Iki kadi ziwiri zinalingana, munalandire pointi na kadi zisakhale ku face up. Iki zinalingana, kadi zikhazikitse ku face down, koma '.',
Game imatola lomwe ziwiri zonse zatchulidwa.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Mawonekedwe olakwika. Wosewera {player_id} sanayankhe ndi malangizo olondola m'mapaketi a mabwalo.
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: Chosayenera. Player {player_id} anasankha malo kunja kwa malire.
invalid_move.same_card_twice: Kusuntha kosaloledwa. Wosewera {player_id} anasankha khadi lomwelo kawiri.
invalid_move.already_matched: Kusuntha kosaloledwa. Wosewera {player_id} anasankha khadi limodzi kapena onse awiri omwe agwirizanitsidwa kale.

game_message.cards_match: Kalata zosankhidwa ndi Player {player_id} pa malo a [{r1} {c1}] ndi [{r2} {c2}] zikafanana!
game_message.cards_no_match: Kalata zosankhidwa ndi Player {player_id} sizikafanana. Kalata pa malo a [{r1} {c1}] ndi [{r2} {c2}] ndi {pos1} ndi {pos2} mtawali.

outcome.draw: Osewera onse aŵiriwo anafanana makadi a m'magulu ofanana.
outcome.turn_limit: Mpaka wa zunguliro zinazowezekana tayari wafikidwa.  Msewero uwu watha. Mchezaji 0 anapata alama {score_0}, Mchezaji 1 anapata alama {score_1}.
